text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's right, Tarumae, dear. I was
meaning to say
thank you for that treat.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I hope you liked it. The daikon was
pickled in
haskap!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It was simply lovely. And such a sweet
pink color.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Heh! Isn't it great?! Haskap berries are
packed
with color, flavor, and vitamins.
They're the best!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I used to go berry picking a lot at the
farms in my
hometown. You have to pick
them gently, one by
one, since they're
so soft.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
They're pretty sour if you eat them raw,
but you
can use them in all sorts of
cooking, even baking!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah! An all-purpose athlete good with
everything...
Is that the kind of idol I
should try to be?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I-I think I've got it. I'm going to become
just like a
haskap—an all-purpose local
idol!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, you don't say. Hehe, Tarumae, you
sure are
a real go-getter.
